script:
[Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$d=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'EasyCV-Downloads-20261102-Chrome'
$p=Join-Path $d 'googlechromestandaloneenterprise_arm64.msi'
$s=Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $p
if($s.Status -ne 'Valid' -or $s.SignerCertificate.Subject -notmatch 'O=Google LLC'){throw 'MSI not trusted'}
$i=Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList '/i',$p,'/L*v',(Join-Path $d 'chrome-msi-install.log') -PassThru
@{installerPID=$i.Id;signatureStatus=[string]$s.Status;mode='Standard interactive MSI; no enterprise enrollment/policy options';installationComplete=$false}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
